notes.title: Treasure Hunter and Easy Mode Update
notes.notes:
Small update fixing a bug on the Treasure Hunter Score where the value passed to the leaderboards was being overwritten by the player score. Now it's working just fine, but we had to reset the Treasure Hunter score.

We also modified the Easy Mode a little. The easy mode wasn't exactly easy and enjoyable for people who are not that good at action games and just want to enjoy some cute alpacas. So we decided to implement a new feature that makes the easy mode much more interesting: the auto aim! 

Now when you play on easy the laser will auto lock on the enemy, making it much easier to shoot, jump and aim at the same time!


What do you think about this update? Please share your thoughts with us!

notes.title: Alpacapaca Dash Huge Update!
notes.notes:
Surprised, aren't ya? Yes, it have been 3 years since the last update! 

Why, you might ask? Simple. After using Godot Engine to develop Alpacapaca Double Dash we fell in love with it. It's such a good engine for pixel art games! While making our 2nd game on it we though how much easier and better Alpacapaca Dash would be if it was made in Godot. So we took a few weeks before starting our 3rd game to remake Alpacapaca Dash in Godot!

To celebrate the new update Alpacapaca Dash AND Alpacapaca Double Dash will be on sale! Take this chance to get both games!

The core gameplay is the same, but we fixed a lot of issues that have been troubling us since a long time. Here is the list of everything that was fixed:

[list]
   [*]fixed blurry graphics
   [*]fixed blurry text.
   [*]improved logo animation at splash screen.
   [*]improved title.
   [*]better death animation for the enemies.
   [*]better laser animation.
   [*]fixed a bug on keybind menu.
   [*]better speed progression of the game.
   [*]jumper powerup became double jump.
   [*]added an animation when the player gets a coin.
   [*]fixed a bug where the snake would fall off the platform.
   [*]fixed a problem where the player would be asked to choose a language all the time.
   [*]improved laser gauge interface and added small details to better show how much the laser gauge increased.
   [*]fixed a bug where the player would become invisible after dying a playing again.
   [*]Now there's no need to enter a name when starting the game. Your steam name will become your player name.
   [*]highscore a tresure hunter score are now stored on steam Leaderboards.
[/list]

obs1: The new update will only work for on windows for now. Soon mac and linux versions will be updated.

ob2: If for any reason you want to play on the old version of the game you can click on Alpacapaca Dash on Steam, then go to Properties>Beta and choose old_version


I hope you enjoy the new updated version of Alpacapaca Dash! Please feel free to enter in contact if you have any suggestions, questions or bug report.

notes.title: Localization Update
notes.notes:
The game is now available in Portuguese (Brazillian) and, thanks to the support of a fan of the game, in Korean! You can now choose the language right before the game starts.

Soon the achievements and store page description will be translated in the languages mentioned above.

Thanks for the awesome support everyone have been giving to the game and stay tuned to some surprises we are preparing to every alpaca lover out there!

notes.title: Super Update!
notes.notes:
The second update of Alpacapaca Dash is finally here! A lot of new features were added and some changes were made and we hope the game is even better. Here is a list of everything that changed:

[b]Update Log[/b]

[list]
[*]Easy and Hard mode added
[*]Controller Support added
[*]Fullscreen toggle added
[*]Fixed problems that were sometimes preventing the achievements "You can shoot lasers you know?" and "Alpaca Fever!" from unlocking
[*]Enemies don't appear behind coins and upgrades anymore.
[*]Now all powers have 50% chance of appearing instead of power downs having 60% and power ups 40%
[*]Added a sprite art of the Goddess sealed in a crystal
[*]Now whenever you gain bonus score, it will be indicated on the screen
[*]Removed the achievement Goddess Blessing and added new achievements: Save the Goddess, Not enough..., Love and Power and Hero of Justice
[*]New Animations will appear after the Goddess in Hard Mode when you keep playing
[*]New enemies added: Imp and Blackstar
[*]Now enemies will appear one after another
[/list]

Thanks to everyone that is supporting and enjoying the game!

notes.title: Updates and Bug Fixes!
notes.notes:
-Now it's possible to rebind keys for the shoot, jump and pause buttons
-Enemy spawn rate was modified and now have a better difficult curve
-Enemies now die instantly when hitting the laser
-The bat have a smaller hitbox
-Changed "Exit" for "Menu" on the Game Over menu
-The three 50 coins alpacas received a visual update
-The game don't freeze when going from the game to the main menu 
-New music added on the menu screen

We tried to make it possible to go from fullscreen to widowed, but there's some unknown problem preventing it from working. A new update will be launched when it's working without problems. Stay tuned for new updates!
